# agent-evidence-atlas

> An atlas of agent assurance (seven layers that make claims about AI agents) with a claim ledger whose every row can be re-derived.

## Docs

- [Site](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/): the framework, the atlas and the version ledger
- [Working in the repository](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/repository.html): files, release rule, commands
- [Claim ledger](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/claims.html): every claim with its source and re-derive command
- [Experiments](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/experiments.html): registered experiments and results
- [Open Evidence Lab](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/lab.html): submitting runs and corrections
